key: datasnipper|senior product manager financial statement suite
title: Senior Product Manager, Financial Statement Suite
jd_excerpt:
Before a company publishes its annual report, finance teams have to turn financial data into a complete set of statements and disclosures. Balances need to be mapped, figures carried forward and updated, and supporting information brought together into a draft. Auditors then check that the notes match the primary statements, this year reconciles with last year, and every total adds up. Preparing and reviewing those statements takes days of detailed work, and errors can carry through into a published report.
 Today, audit teams rely on Financial Statement Suite (FSS) to read statements, run checks, and show reviewers what it found and where, so they can make the call and stand behind it. The opportunity goes beyond reconciliation: helping auditors and financial professionals review drafts, connect figures to supporting evidence, and manage changes through to sign-off.
 You'll own what FSS becomes across preparation and review cycles. You'll decide what sits on the teams roadmap and define strategy for this high opportunity area working with engineering, design, audit experts and the firms who use FSS every day.
 About DataSnipper 
 The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust. 
 We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.
 At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.
 For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.
 And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers . Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.
 If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way. 
 What impact you will have 
 Own the end-to-end strategy and decisions for our financial statements product, with clear domain ownership
 Lead product direction in a key area with direct and clear business impact
 Reimagine how auditors and financial professionals work, making their workflows more defensible
 Why it's an exciting challenge 
 Reviewers are sceptical, and they should be. A finding they can't trace is a finding they check again by hand.
 Statements differ by country, by standard and by firm. FSS has to be right on all of them, not just the ones in front of you this week.
 Firms use FSS when the stakes are highest. Every change has to make their next busy season better, not riskier.
 Everyone has a request: firms, sales, partners and engineering. You'll decide which ones the evidence supports, and say no to the rest.
 What you'll own 
 The full FS experience: how a team moves through a draft, from the first finding to sign-off
 Trust in every check: each finding shows what it compared, where the figures came from, and who reviewed it
 Quality: what "ready to ship" means for each check, and how the team knows a change helps without breaking something else
 Where FSS goes next: which statement types, standards and markets come first, and why
 What you'll do 
 Set the plan and make trade-offs explicit, including new checks versus improving the ones customers already rely on
 Spend time with auditors: watch real reviews, see where they double-check by hand, and turn that into product decisions
 Work with engineering and audit experts on sets of real statements that every change has to pass
 Use product data to decide: which findings reviewers accept, reject or ignore, and why
 Build on Alwin's shared platform capabilities, and raise dependencies with other teams early
 Help sales and customer success decide which customers and statements FSS is ready for
 Write clearly: decisions, specs, and requirements so the team can drive forward with clarity and speed
 What you'll bring 
 Must-have: 
 Product management experience on B2B software where getting it right matters: audit, accounting, tax, legal, compliance or financial services
 A strong business acumen and focus on business impact
 Experience shipping AI, machine learning or document-processing features, and making their output something people can check
 Comfort with data: you can read an error analysis, query your own numbers and spot a sample that isn't representative
 A record of prioritising for a large user base with demanding customers and competing stakeholders both internal and external
 Enough technical depth to make trade-offs with engineers on accuracy, data and architecture
 Strong-to-have: 
 An audit or accounting background, or deep knowledge of financial reporting (IFRS, US GAAP, UK GAAP)
 Creative mindset thinking beyond how problems are solved today to reimagine a future approach that drive productivity

 Be part of one of the fastest-growing, profitable unicorn scale-ups in the Netherlands with a global impact.
 Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights) to share in the company’s success and growth.
 Pension plan with a 6% contribution on top of your base salary.
 28 vacation days per year (full-time) to support your work-life balance.
